key_features: SIX SCRUBBING SPONGES: This pack of Scotch-Brite Odor Resist Non-Scratch Scrub Sponges includes 1 pack of six sponges.
SCRUBS FAST AND STAYS CLEAN: Scotch-Brite Odor Resist Non-Scratch Sponges are innovative kitchen sponges for cleaning that scrub fast and stay clean.
RINSES CLEAN EVERY TIME: Even eggs and cheese won’t stick to these easy-to-clean scrub sponges.
ODOR FREE GUARANTEE**: Odor Resist technology helps these antibacterial-treated* dish sponges resist bacterial odors for up to 3 weeks of use – guaranteed**.
SAFE ON MOST SURFACES: Multipurpose scrubbers for cleaning dishes, nonstick pots and pans, countertops, glass, tubs, showers, and more. Do not use on stainless steel appliances.
review_summary: Say bye-bye stinky sponges, and hello to Scotch-Brite Odor Resist Non-Scratch Sponges, innovative kitchen sponges that scrub fast and stay clean. They’re gentle enough for almost any surface and rinse clean every time – even eggs and cheese won’t stick. Thanks to Odor Resist tech…
